AI Use Log

Tool: Claude

What AI helped with

  • Dataset documentation (R/data.R): Claude drafted the roxygen text. I wrote all 26 clues myself and checked the answers.
  • check_answer: Claude helped with the cleaning steps: gsub(“[^a-z0-9 ]”, ““, x) to drop punctuation such as the apostrophe in”Wernicke’s area”, and sub(“s$”, ““, x) to ignore a final”s”. I tested them with my own examples.
  • new_game: Claude gave the constructor that makes the S3 class “alphabet_game”. I wrote the documentation wording.
  • print.alphabet_game: Claude helped give me the format for the print method so the answers stay hidden.
  • play_game: Claude helped give vague codes when I did not know how to loop with the Sys.time() timer and readline().
  • devtools::check(): Claude explained the two notes. I added AI_USE.md to .Rbuildignore and used MCATAlphagame::mcat_clues.

What I did myself

  • The game idea and the 26 MCAT clues.
  • Testing every function in the Console.
  • Documentation wording and my own edits.

Other

I also used AI to put me in the right direction when I did not know how to get an output I wanted or how to word the code.
